title: A Deep Learning-Aided Automated Method for Calculating Metabolic Tumor Volume in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
summary: A deep-learning method automated metabolic-tumor-volume measurement in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma PET/CT and was compared with expert reader assessment. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
